title: The Machine of Sector Nine
author: Oscar Thornbury
blurb: Cyrus Okonkwo, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
